description.description: One line that says what this task is. model-router sends it with the goal to Jev, which judges the model and effort the child needs.

reasoning_effort.description: Leave it unset unless you re-dispatch a failed task. The child runs at this effort, and model-router still picks its model. A delegation.reasoning_effort in the user's config wins.

level.description: Leave it unset unless you re-dispatch a failed task. 0 runs the child on the user's small model, 1 on the user's middle model, 2 on the large model, and model-router asks Jev nothing. A level whose model is not set runs on the model Hermes gives it. A routed task's label shows its level as L0, L1 or L2. A model in the user's delegation config wins.

delegationAddendum: model-router picks each task's model and effort. Give every task a description. Leave reasoning_effort and level unset unless you re-dispatch a failed task; the model-router-hermes:model-router skill says how.

texts.toolDescription: Reads the router's settings. With no input it returns the provider, the three models, and whether each key the provider allows is set. With a setting name (provider, typesafe_key, openrouter_key, small_model, middle_model, large_model) it returns how the person changes that setting. It changes nothing and never returns a key.
texts.commandDescription: Shows or changes which providers score subagent calls: auto, openrouter-first, typesafe, openrouter.
texts.useOneOf: provider: use one of auto, openrouter-first, typesafe, openrouter
texts.refused: provider unchanged: only a local session can change it
texts.badCall: Unknown setting. Pass no setting, or one of: provider, typesafe_key, openrouter_key, small_model, middle_model, large_model

help.provider:
Type /model-router-provider <value> in the chat.
provider: use one of auto, openrouter-first, typesafe, openrouter
help.typesafe_key: Set TYPESAFE_API_KEY in the .env file of the Hermes home, or enter the key in the plugin's settings form in Hermes Desktop. Never type a key into the chat.
help.openrouter_key: Set OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the .env file of the Hermes home. Never type a key into the chat.
help.small_model: small_model is set in the plugin's settings form in Hermes Desktop, or in config.yaml under plugins.entries.model-router-hermes.settings.small_model, or with: hermes config set plugins.entries.model-router-hermes.settings.small_model '{"provider": "<provider>", "model": "<model>"}'
help.middle_model: middle_model is set in the plugin's settings form in Hermes Desktop, or in config.yaml under plugins.entries.model-router-hermes.settings.middle_model, or with: hermes config set plugins.entries.model-router-hermes.settings.middle_model '{"provider": "<provider>", "model": "<model>"}'
help.large_model: large_model is set in the plugin's settings form in Hermes Desktop, or in config.yaml under plugins.entries.model-router-hermes.settings.large_model, or with: hermes config set plugins.entries.model-router-hermes.settings.large_model '{"provider": "<provider>", "model": "<model>"}'
